3462.title: Retained turns survive idle stop
3462.rootCauseOneLine: Idle stop sends release; the daemon retains active turns but returns the same success result as a completed release.
3462.proposedFix: Define a distinguishable release outcome and explicit-stop reconciliation while preserving the active-turn race guard.
3462.caveats: Component-level diagnostic, repeated without test cache in a second clean checkout. Original provider failure and live retry/tell behavior remain unverified. Test and output are inline in HTML under reports repository policy.
